mapper.select: SELECT md.instrument_id, md.symbol, md.price, md.change, md.change_percent, md.timestamp FROM market_data md ORDER BY md.symbol
SELECT instrument_id, symbol, price, change, change_percent, timestamp FROM market_data WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO market_data (instrument_id, symbol, price, change, change_percent, timestamp) VALUES (#{instrumentId}, #{symbol}, #{price}, #{change}, #{changePercent}, #{timestamp}) ON CONFLICT (instrument_id) DO UPDATE SET price = EXCLUDED.price, change = EXCLUDED.change, change_percent = EXCLUDED.change_percent, timestamp = EXCLUDED.timestamp
